summary: Plan inclusive community projects with practical participation, feedback, and accountability tools. Explore the five-day training outline.
lede: Community-based project design brings affected people into shaping priorities, activities and delivery decisions. For project officers, engagement practitioners and programme leads, this training develops practical ways to plan inclusive participation and guide community-facing delivery. You will practise social mapping and stakeholder analysis, design community scorecards and accessible feedback routes, and use safeguarding checks and adaptive action planning to respond to community priorities.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who coordinate community participation, manage local project delivery, or make decisions about how feedback affects services and resources.
modules: Community Action Plans and Results Review
prerequisites: Prior experience coordinating a project or community-facing activity is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
